title: PromptingRule
description: An object describing the structure of a rule.

user.description: The UID for which the rule applies.

snap.description: The name of the snap for which the rule applies.

interface.description: The interface for which the rule applies.

lifespan.description:
The lifespan for which the permission applies.

timespan: the permission applies for the given duration specified by the
duration field or until it is deleted

session: the permission applies until the user logs out (specifically,
until the systemd user session ends)

forever: the permission applies until it is deleted

expiration.description:
The timestamp at which the permission will expire. Required if lifespan
is timespan, otherwise must be omitted.

session-id.description:
The opaque session ID used for session-based permissions. Required if
lifespan is session, otherwise must be omitted.

PromptingRuleConstraintsCamera.description: Details about the applicability of the existing rule to requests.

permissions.description: A map linking the permission name to it's respective information.

PromptingRuleConstraintsHome.description: Details about the applicability of the existing rule to requests.

path-pattern.description: Path glob matching filepaths for which the rule applies.
